factor_identifiability.factor_level: Evaluated only where the frozen scenario marks factors identifiable.
factor_identifiability.subspace_level: Always preserved for designated rotationally ambiguous scenarios; principal angles/projection distance are required downstream.

format.dtype: float32 for molecular and latent numeric arrays

generative_equation: X_view = block_scale_view * (shared_signal_strength * f_view(Z_bio diag(s) W_bio_view^T) + private_signal_strength * Z_private_view W_private_view^T + batch_effect_strength * Z_technical W_technical_view^T + feature_offset + Gaussian_noise), followed by the frozen row-pairing corruption and missingness mechanism.
guardrails: 05a and 05a1 are verified by SHA256 before generation.
The 04d technical preflight is verified by SHA256 before generation.
No representation, survival or biological result is read or fitted.
The disclosed sable_mo_v1 pilot is never modified or reused for confirmatory evaluation.
Only the combined architecture-screening registry is materialized.
The final gate-calibration registry is not materialized by this script.
Every dataset contains exact known biological, private and technical truth.
No stability threshold is tuned or evaluated in this script.

materialization_scope.final_gate_calibration: not materialized until architecture selection is complete and frozen
materialization_scope.pre_addendum_v1_pilot: preserved, disclosed and ineligible for confirmatory results

pair_corruption: RNA remains in canonical order; methylation and CNV receive independent exact derangements of the frozen row fraction.

technical_metadata_preflight.consequence: Technical batch truth is formally stress-tested in simulations; real TARGET factors retain technical-status-unknown unless later supported by independent evidence.
technical_metadata_preflight.interpretation: Cosmetic source-discovery accounting discrepancy; the frozen parsed source inventory is authoritative for downstream audit provenance.

truth_layers.biological_shared: Factor-specific ALL3 or pair-view support with exact score, loading, support-mask and truth-class arrays.
truth_layers.complete_observed_matrix: Observed row ordering after any intentional pairing corruption, before missing-value masking.
truth_layers.missingness: Per-cell reason codes with separate base MCAR, feature-structured, sample-quality, partial-view and batch-dependent mechanisms.
truth_layers.private: View-specific score and loading arrays; selected null scenarios may correlate corresponding private scores across views without creating biological shared truth.
truth_layers.technical: Known binary-batch label, continuous technical score, exact view support, loadings and batch/biology correlation.
